pattern.description: The regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: The file or directory to search; the workspace root by default. It may also be a read-only root such as a Go module directory.

glob.description: Only search files whose path matches this glob, such as *.go (a file name at any depth) or **/*.tsx. A pattern with a slash is matched against the whole path, relative to the workspace root or absolute in a read-only root.

output_mode.description: files_with_matches lists the matching files, content prints the matching lines with their line numbers, count prints the number of matching lines per file.

context.description: Lines of context around each match in content mode, at most 20.

head_limit.description: Return at most this many result lines; all of them by default (the result is cut at 32 KiB).

offset.description: Skip this many result lines first, to read the next page.
